description: Conservative log signatures for automatic failure triage. Matches suggest investigation categories; they never prove root cause or success.

guidance: Check that the required Synopsys feature is licensed for this tool/stage.
Check the license-server environment and connectivity outside the flow.
Do not alter design constraints to work around a license failure.
Verify setup.sh and PATH resolve the intended tool executable.
Record the resolved executable and version before retrying.

patterns: required output patterns are missing or unusable
guidance: Inspect the stage output-contract JSON and identify the first missing, empty, non-regular, or escaped artifact.
Treat a tool exit code of zero as insufficient until required outputs are proven usable.
Fix the generating stage or its configured output path before capturing a reusable checkpoint fingerprint.
Confirm the command belongs to the shell used for this stage.
Use the installed Synopsys release documentation/man command to verify syntax.
Prefer a release-compatible fallback rather than inventing replacement syntax.
Identify the first missing required input and the stage expected to generate it.
Check central project/technology configuration rather than hard-coding a path in the failing script.
Use the rebuild planner if an upstream generated artifact is missing or stale.
Inspect the earliest RTL parser/elaboration error, not only the final abort message.
Verify RTL file order, include directories, preprocessor definitions, and TOP_MODULE.
Do not continue to timing/physical stages while unresolved design references remain.
Verify target/link libraries and NDM references correspond to the mapped netlist cells.
Check that logical and physical library views are from the intended technology/version.
Do not substitute guessed cell or library names.
Verify the SDC loaded successfully and the configured clock port exists after elaboration/link.
Audit unexpected unconstrained paths before interpreting WNS/TNS.
Do not add false paths or multicycle paths solely to suppress violations.
Verify the SPEF matches the exact post-route netlist hierarchy and naming.
Check extraction corner/model consistency with the PrimeTime scenario.
Treat incomplete parasitic annotation as a signoff blocker when extracted STA is required.
Inspect legality, congestion, route status, and DRC reports at the failing checkpoint.
Diagnose floorplan/utilization/macro-channel causes before applying broad optimization changes.
Keep geometric DRC separate from max-transition/capacitance/fanout constraints.
Inspect unmatched, failing, and aborted points before changing the RTL or constraints.
Confirm reference/implementation tops, libraries, SVF guidance, parameters, and preprocessing are aligned.
Do not mark formal PASS from a tool exit code alone.
Check host memory, swap, disk capacity, quotas, and scheduler limits.
Preserve the last valid checkpoint before changing host-resource settings.
A crash/resource exhaustion is not evidence of a design failure.
